title: bffgen project config
description: bffgen.config.json (Node.js: Express, Fastify) and bffgen.config.py.json (Python: FastAPI). `bffgen generate` reads the backends; the other sections are written by `bffgen init` and are informational. Go projects use bff.config.yaml (schemas/bffgen-v1.json).

async.description: Python only. Generated proxy routes are always async.

aggregates.description: GET routes that call several backends in parallel and answer {data, sources}. A failed optional source leaves its data null (partial response); a failed required source, or every source failing, fails the route (502/503/504, or the source's 4xx).

milliseconds.description: A time in milliseconds, or a duration string such as "5s", "500ms" or "1m"

name.description: Unique backend name. Node.js: letters, digits, '-' and '_' (it becomes file names and require() paths). Names may not differ only in case or in '-' vs '_'.

retries.description: Extra attempts for GET, HEAD and OPTIONS (default 2)

resetTimeout.description: How long the circuit stays open (default 30000 ms)

endpoints.description: Routes proxied to this backend. May be omitted for a backend used only by aggregates.

path.description: Node.js: the backend path. Python: the path the BFF exposes. Parameters as :id or {id}.

exposeAs.description: Node.js: the path the BFF exposes

roles.description: Also require one of these roles (from the token's roles/role claim or JWT_ROLES_CLAIM); otherwise 403. Implies requiresAuth.

name.description: Used in comments and handler names

exposeAs.description: The GET path the BFF exposes. Parameters as :id or {id}.

roles.description: Also require one of these roles; otherwise 403. Implies requiresAuth.

backend.description: Name of a backend in backends; its timeout, retries and circuit breaker apply

path.description: GET path on the backend; may carry a query string. Parameters (:id or {id}) come from exposeAs.

as.description: Key of this source in data and sources (default: the backend name)

required.description: If this source fails, the whole route fails instead of answering with its data null
